title: Cubic generator order principal witness
objective: Independently replay and mutation-test the exact principal witness for the nontrivial cubic class generator order relation I^24 using the existing signed genback output

oracles: exact ideal arithmetic replay from authenticated x^3-200*x+7 signed-genback data
mutation rejection for ideal, exponent, factor, and principal-generator corruption

handoff.summary: Added a new-files-only frozen replay leaf for the authentic x^3-200*x+7 class generator. Ordinary Python exact column-HNF arithmetic crosses the prior 64-bit modulus limit, raises the generator ideal to order 24 in six products, independently HNF-normalizes the exact principal element, retains the signed-genback factor and reduction trace, and publishes only after all nine ideal cells agree. The checker pins pristine PARI 2.17.4, covers CPython plus JavaScript/GMP/tagged native backends, and transactionally rejects five provenance or witness mutations.
risks: The compact genback factor authentication is deliberately frozen to this one PARI correspondence fixture; this is not a generic factor evaluator.
The exact principal generator remains correspondence input. Deriving it from retained principal relation elements is a later generalization.

Only the focused Linux-x64 checker and source/JavaScript syntax checks were run in this lane; broad test:changed/native suites were explicitly deferred to integration to avoid contending with the active campaign.
next_steps: Integrate the leaf and attach its power ideal, principal HNF, six-step reduction trace, and retained compact factors to the nontrivial class generator result.
Generalize the principal-generator construction from durable exact relation witnesses once those inputs are available.
